description: This source file defines data models and request payload classes related to Asset management within a feature module of a backend system. It includes DTOs for persisting asset records and request classes for creating, updating, deleting, and querying assets.

classes.name: AssetDto
classes.description: Represents a persisted asset with properties mapped to a database table.

classes.name: CreateAssetRequest
classes.description: Request payload for creating a new asset, includes validation attributes.

classes.name: UpdateAssetRequest
classes.description: Request payload for updating an existing asset, includes validation attributes.

classes.name: DeleteAssetRequest
classes.description: Request payload for soft-deleting an asset, includes audit fields.

classes.name: QueryAssetsRequest
classes.description: Defines optional filtering and limiting parameters for querying assets.
